articleTitle: A Novel Lorenz-Rossler-Chan (LRC) Algorithm for Efficient Chaos-Based Voice Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In recent years, many proposed algorithms have been used to enhance the performance of voice encryption over public communication channels. This paper introduces the novel Lorenz-Rossler-Chan (LRC) algorithm for voice encryption using three chaotic system generators: Lorenz, Rossler, and Chen. The LRC chaotic system combines cascaded chaotic signals from these generators to enhance encryption performance and increase the key space. The simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the LRC algorithm. Encrypted voice signals exhibit significantly negative signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and zero correlation values showcase negligible similarities, highlighting a substantial difference between the original and encrypted voice signals, indicating robust encryption. The proposed LRC algorithm is also well suited for real-time applications because of its minimal time delay during encryption and decryption, which further hinders decryption. With a key space of approximately 1196 bits, the LRC algorithm has strong security.

articleTitle: Compact SIW BPF Loaded with a Tree Shaped Fractal Slot for LEO Satellite Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This article presents a miniaturized substrate-integrated waveguide (SIW) bandpass filter (BPF) based on fractal geometry. The proposed filter miniaturization is achieved by etching a slot on the top layer of the structure using a tree-slotted fractal technique. The BPF covers a frequency range from 11.49 GHz to 12.24 GHz, with a fractional bandwidth (FBW) of 6.42% centered at 11.87 GHz. The miniaturized filter demonstrates improved scattering parameter characteristics with a high rejection band in both the lower and upper-frequency regions, resulting in a more compact SIW cavity. The passband poles of the filter are located at 11.78 GHz and 11.92 GHz, with reflection coefficient (S11) values of −37 dB and −30.4 dB, respectively. The insertion loss (IL) is measured to be 1.1 dB with return loss (RL) better than 27.5 dB with a group delay of about 1.6989 ns. The unloaded SIW BPF is still bulky compared to the microstrip BPF. To miniaturize it, a second iteration of tree-shaped fractal slots has been etched into the top layer of the proposed structure. The presented filter occupies an area of 17.8×8.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (1.17×0.56 λg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). Rogers RO4003c substrate was used to build the proposed filter. The substrate has a relative permittivity of 3.55 with a loss tangent of 0.0027 and a thickness of 0.508 mm. Finally, a simulation of the compact single-layered second-order Chebyshev SIW-based BPF design was implemented, and results were verified in two widely used full-wave simulators, Ansys EDT and CST.

articleTitle: Improving Digital Video Broadcasting DVB-T2 Lite System Performance by Applying Convolutional Interleaver
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The digital video broadcasting’s second generation terrestrial technology, DVBT2, is regarded as an enhanced variant DVBT. When compared with other terrestrial standards that are now available, it provides the highest levels of efficiency, dependability, and flexibility. Furthermore, the traditional DVB-T2 is regarded as the basic component for the T2 lite system (DVBT2’s mobile configuration). One crucial component of DVB-T2 technology is the interleaver element, since the type of interleaver has a significant impact on the system, the purpose of this study is to compare the T2 Lite system’s performance before and after the interleaver is applied. Three various scenarios are considered: the first scenario is obtained without any interleaver, and the next two cases are generated using two common types of interleavers, namely block interleaver and convolutional interleaver. To determine which of the three scenarios produces better performance, a comparison is made between them. The effectiveness of two modulation techniques, QPSK and 16QAM, is assessed using two types of channels (fixed and an additive white Gaussian noise channel) at a 2/3 coding rate. MATLAB R2022a has been used to simulate the suggested model. The results show that, in comparison to other simulation scenarios, the convolutional interleaver’s bit error rate (BER) is the lowest. Using a convolutional interleaver enhances the proposed system’s enactment.

articleTitle: Auto Detection Hard Exudates by Using VistaView Devise Based on Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Untreated diabetic retinopathy (DR) can lead to various levels of visual impairment and potentially complete loss of eyesight. Annual eye examinations are crucial in identifying potential visual impairments, especially for individuals with diabetes, to prevent early-stage vision deterioration. Technological advancements have made retinal imaging technologies for cell phones commercially available, enabling cost-effective and efficient screening for diabetic retinopathy in various settings. This study examines multiple approaches to handling retinal images in ophthalmology to identify and assess abnormalities. Fundus cameras are expensive and heavy, making compact, portable, and reasonable retinal imaging technologies for quick DR screening necessary. The Vistaview retinal imaging system, with its superior image quality and extensive field of view, is examined for DR screening during a general health exam. The effectiveness of MRLS, a multilevel rhombus segmentation method, is investigated for identifying lesions in retinal images caused by conditions like diabetic retinopathy. This work is a significant step towards developing reliable and effective strategies for diagnosing and treating retinal disorders promptly.

articleTitle: Design of Real-Time Drone Positioning System Based on Multiple Signal Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Recently, there has been a great development in drone technology and its multiple uses in all security, military, commercial, health and entertainment fields Despite its many benefits, some criminal or terrorist groups can use drones to carry out their criminal activities due to their easy access. Radar systems suffer from many challenges in detecting drone locations due to their small size and low-altitude flight. In this paper, a system designed and implemented to track and monitor the real-time radio frequency of drones using an array antenna and cloud servers. It consists of software-defined radios (4-RTL-SDR) that used to form an array antenna to receive the drone’s radio frequency signal. The signal source locations (DOA, direction of arrival) are estimated using the MUSIC (Multiple Signal Classification) algorithm. An Android application used on any mobile device is used to read the results by connecting to the cloud server over the Internet. The proposed system is tested using the simulation program in MATLAB 2017b and practical application. The results obtained through the simulation and practical application are compared and discussed.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of SC and SCL Polar Decoders Inside an Indoor Transmission Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Digital communications took long step to evolve in order to handle the massive data load that ever increasing with time. However, higher bitrates are accompanied with higher bit errors that limit data transmission speed. Therefore, new elaborate low complexity encoding techniques are invented to reduce the Bit Error Rate (BER). The latest elegant technique is the polar code that promises near Shannon limit transmission. This paper investigates the performance of the polar code inside a practical indoor multipath environment using two different decoding techniques that are the Successive Cancellation (SC) and the Successive Cancellation List (SCL) with L = 1 compared to the Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK). The results showed that the SC BER performance is identical to the SCL despite and the SCL is simpler and uses less circuitry.

articleTitle: Web Scraping Social Media Using Support Vector Machine (SVM)
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Social Media Applications, especially Facebook, have revolutionized marketing. This paper presents a method using Facebook Scraper and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to classify pages based on likes and followers. The study, focused on Iraq, reveals preferences for clothing pages. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of SVM in understanding user interests. The Support Vector Machine was used to classify these pages. The aim of this work is to find out the pages or items preferred by people based on the number of likes and followers on these pages. Moreover, the popular interests were also classified for further analysis. In this research, Iraq was used as the case study. This work achieved an 85% accuracy in classifying user preferences on Facebook pages using SVM by splitting our dataset into two groups test and training sets, the results were presented as charts and found the pages that the Iraqi community preferred and had the most likes are the cloth and fashion pages.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Optical Communication System Based on Ultra-high Capacity WDM-SDM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Optical communication system has become a developed and widely used technology due to the increasing demand for high bandwidth which provides high speeds and data transmission capacity. This research presents a design for a space division multiplexing (SDM) transmission system based on few-mode fiber. In this paper, four modes are used to obtain ultra-high data rates. This system similarly utilizes wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) techniques to increment the data transmission rate of the system. The design of the WDM/SDM system was simulated, and the analysis of transmission parameters was done using OptiSystem 18 software. We tested the proposed system in different cases. The system performance is evaluated and analyzed through various parameters: the worth of the quality factor, the bit error rate analyzer, and the amplitude of the eye diagram’s opening. Where obtained the best quality factor of 59.1721 at a data rate of 109 b/s and a fiber length of 10 km.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Negative Output DC-DC Luo Converter: A Review Paper
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This paper presents three techniques for boosting the efficiency of negative output DC-DC Luo Converters. The first technique explained is the elementary-lift Luo converter, which achieves its best operation with fuzzy sliding mode control. The second technique is the Self-Lift Luo converter which employs PID mode control to enhance efficiency and stabilize power. The third technique is the negative output Super Lift Luo Converter, where PI mode control is applied to achieve higher voltage gain while reducing ripple. This paper presents a detailed comparative analysis of the different types of DC-DC Luo converters, focusing on the output ripple and the voltage gain produced for each approach. The super-lift technique. out of all methods, provides the highest voltage gain, which is particularly important for applications where substantial voltage increase is needed. This work represents attempts at energy conversion technology progress by providing an elaborate methodology for controlling the different types of Luo DC-DC converters. This is essential for upcoming developments and meets the requirements of numerous energy conversion processes while increasing efficiency and reliability in the field.

articleTitle: Utilizing Generative Adversarial Networks Compensator in 4X4 MIMO 5G Backhaul Convergence with Radio-over Fiber (RoF) System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The utilization of fiber systems for transmitting Millimeter-Wave (MMW) signals has gained significant traction in recent years, particularly for advanced wireless communication applications such as 5G and beyond. However, wirelessly transmitting MM-Wave radio signals via the atmosphere experiences significant signal deterioration, known as attenuation. To address this constraint, it is beneficial to utilize Radio Over Fiber (RoF) technology wherever possible. This study investigates developments in the combination of wireless and optical networks RoF and compensates for the error by Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). The proposed system is constructed by utilizing the simulation programs VPIphotonics and Python. VPIphotonics (Ver.11.1) and Python (Ver. 3.7.6) are programming platforms designed to develop algorithms, analyze data and applications, and design models in real-time to compensate for the errors that occur in the proposed system. GANs used to compensate for errors in the RoF system shows a sophisticated application of machine learning techniques to improve signal integrity and reduce distortions. The 4X4 MIMO proposed system has a bandwidth of 17 GHz and reached a data rate of 133.33 Gb/s; the centre frequency is 160 GHz. This signal is transmitted over fiber lengths (50 km) with EVM ≈ 4.5 at the 50 km distance and 4.5 % with data rate Gb/s for the 4X4 MIMO proposed system.

articleTitle: Robust Automatic Modulation Recognition Using Convolutional Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This work looks into Automated Modulation Categorization (AMC), essential in military and civil projects. The Convolutional neural networks (CNN) form the foundation of a powerful AMC technique that is described in this paper to solve the existing drawback of many FB AMC techniques where they are designed to detect a limited number of modulation types and cannot easily be adapted to work with other types of modulation. It also saves power and increases accuracy. Eleven forms of modulation are analyzed in total across all categories. The two forms of conventional AMCs are feature-based and maximum likelihood (ML). Here, an efficient AMC method that makes use of CNN is proposed and implemented for modulation classification. The described approach may partition the incoming signals and decide systematically about their properties with no need for feature extraction. It also determines the most effective optimizer between the two approaches over the three different signal-to-noise ratios (high, medium, and low). The two methods are Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) and Stochastic Gradient Descent with Momentum (SGdm). A comparative analysis between the proposed CNN-based AMCs was performed.

articleTitle: Modeling and Performance Evaluationof a TIACMOS Amplifier with Shunt Inductive Feedback at 0.18 μm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In contemporary analog circuit design, designing a transimpedance amplifier (TIA) using Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) technology is essential, especially for high-speed, low-noise applications. PMOS and NMOS in shunt inductive negative feedback transistors are used in this proposed design to increase power efficiency, gain, and bandwidth. Complementary transistor pairs drive the output of the planned CMOS TIA. The primary benefit of this configuration is the ability to maintain high bandwidth while offering low output impedance. The design arrangement effectively supports positive and negative fluctuations, reducing distortion and improving linearity. This is crucial for high-speed signal processing applications, such as optical receivers. By operating the suggested system, a gain of 64 dB is achieved. Noise and speed performance are balanced by adjusting the transimpedance gain. CMOS TIA systems achieve a gain-bandwidth quotient (GBP) of 786 MHz, a crucial factor. The gain-bandwidth quotient shows the amplifier's capacity to sustain high gain and broad frequency response.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of the All-Optical Chaotic System over Free-Space Optical Communication Link under Different Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: To solve data security concerns, semiconductor laser chaos generation is currently being used to increase data security and prevent data theft during its transmission from the transmitter to receivers. Chaotic lasers are extensively employed in secure communication, where optical chaotic communication is a hopeful technique for improving the privacy and security of communications networks. Our proposed method, which uses the double-delay feedback mechanism to generate the optical chaotic signal, hides the information within the chaos in this type of secure communication system. Chaotic data a mix of incoming signals and optical chaotic, is sent via Free-space optical (FSO). The different channel lengths of data transfer are implemented for communication and under various weather conditions such as ideal conditions, fog, and rain. Synchronization between the sending and receiving sides is achieved by adjusting the parameters on both sides. By subtracting the chaos from the sent signal on the receiving side, the received signal can be returned to its initial state. It is possible to assess the method by obtaining Q-factors and bit error rates (BERs), which can then be used to determine the quality of the received signal. Based on our comparison of Q-factors and BER values for channels of various lengths and different weather conditions, the increase of the FSO channel length caused a link distance degradation at all weather conditions. In addition, the fog and rain caused attenuation and scattering of the light signal increasing the bit error rate (BER) and a decrease in the Q-factor.

articleTitle: Real Time Automatization of Greenhouse Environment Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This study investigates the incorporation of real-time automation in greenhouse settings by utilizing cloud computing technology. This study focuses on the optimization and regulation of the greenhouse climate and conditions, which are essential for promoting optimal plant growth and agricultural productivity. Environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, and soil moisture are consistently monitored through the implementation of sensors and automated systems using 3 sensors. The primary innovation is found in the seamless incorporation of cloud-based computing, which facilitates the remote use of sensor data for purposes such as access, storage, and processing. Furthermore, the utilization of cloud infrastructure with mobile application enables enhanced scalability and accessibility for all stakeholders, hence enabling the capability of real-time monitoring and controlling from multiple geographical locations. Results demonstrate significant improvements in controlled conditions compared to non-controlled settings. Specifically, under controlled conditions, temperature variations were limited to 2.82°C (from 24.14°C to 26.96°C), compared to 9.09°C (from 20.13°C to 29.22°C) in non-controlled environments. Similarly, soil moisture was maintained between 88% and 100% in the controlled system, avoiding the complete depletion observed in non-controlled conditions.

articleTitle: Capacity Enhancement Frequency Hopping System Under Multi Input Multi Output Jamming Channel
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This study examines how increasing the frequency hopping rate parameter in the communications system improves transmission information. This is done without adding power or bandwidth utilising frequency hopping spread spectrum (FHSS). This preserves the original data’s anti-jamming capabilities. FH and spectral features of the frequency-hopping widened signal, a carrier reconstruction-based demodulation technique, are examined. Analysing FH transmission’s extended signal power suggests bit error rate performance, capacity increase, and anti-jamming. Militaries employ frequency hopping spread spectrum to protect communication between command centres, troops, vehicles, sensors, missile launchers, etc. It protects against selective frequency fading and works well in interference settings.

articleTitle: Performance LTE Downlink Based on MIMO-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The transmission approach used for the downlink of the broadly used Long Term Evolution (LTE) technology is orthogonal frequency department multiplexing, or OFDM. This multi-carrier approach treats frequency selective fading as flat fading and splits a huge device bandwidth into several narrowband sub-carriers. To boom facts rates and gadget overall performance, LTE uses Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO-OFDM) transmission in aggregate with OFDM. This look at uses OFDM generation to evaluate the spectrum universal overall performance and useful resource allocation in the LTE device’s downlink. The energy distribution throughout the frequency spectrum and the usage of time-frequency sources have been investigated with the use of a spectrum analyzer and resource grid displays. Excessive balance in spectrum overall performance became examined, and the tool’s flexibility in allocating useful assets based solely on statistical call for became proven by way of the extensive gains in primary frequency processing and a few unused time slots within the grid. The evaluation demonstrates how nicely LTE performs in accomplishing high spectrum performance with a dynamic model to community desires. The furnished works analyze LTE sign performance via using QPSK and 64- QAM modulation schemes through spectrum evaluation, highlighting variations in bandwidth performance and statistics charges. Additionally, the beneficial aid grid visualizations display dynamic allocation of time-frequency assets for information and manage channels, ensuring optimized verbal exchange. This take a look at emphasizes the stability between spectral performance and gadget reliability in LTE networks.

articleTitle: Employment of Meta Technologies for Efficient Design of a Planner Antenna at 5G Frequency Bands
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The mobile technologies dominate the wireless communications recently. The reason behind the outstanding interest of many researchers about the technology development that related to the mobile generation and wireless communication, which leads to fast evolution of these generations in the current and last two decade of this century from 3G, 4G, and 5G, but the technologies used in 5G still need more development and improvement for a compact and efficient device. In this manuscript, meta technique employs for improving main parameters of antenna performance like gain bandwidth (BW), reflection coefficient and radiation efficiency. The proposed antenna design shows multi resonant frequency that mean the design able to operate at multiband of frequencies, which include 6Ghz band, the targeted band of 4G and 5G mobile communication technologies. The simulation results for the different model of adding metasurface to the proposed design show clear improvement to the performance parameters, beside the reducing of the resonant frequency that mean it can serve the lower frequency via small size of substrate, which makes it suitable for many applications.

articleTitle: Recognizing Computed Tomography-Scan Images In Deferent Ways: A Review Paper
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Computed tomography (CT) scans have become an indispensable tool in contemporary medicine as they enable more precise diagnosis, treatment planning, and patient management across a broad range of medical fields as they provide detailed cross-sectional images. They are crucial in both regular and emergency medicolegal conditions due to rapid imaging and ease of use. Image processing is essential in order to achieve the ultimate level of precision and relative accuracy for diagnosing any sort of disease within present government medical diagnostics & treatment. The use of intelligent algorithms and techniques by healthcare professionals on digital radiography, X-ray, and CT images could facilitate the diagnosis in its early phases and thus predict prospective patient outcomes. Image recognition technology is increasingly vital in the medical field, enhancing diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, medical image recognition can significantly improve the interpretation of medical images, aiding in early disease detection and treatment planning. Image recognition provides comprehensive data that supports clinical decisions, enhancing the overall quality of care.

articleTitle: Communication Protocols in PLC-Based Data Acquisition for Wastewater Management
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Wastewater treatment facilities are necessary to safeguard the environment and lessen the harmful effects of contaminated water. To create pure water fit for human consumption, these treatments go through several exacting procedures in both their chemical and electrical stages. To obtain necessary advantages, such as using them to produce electrical energy and other advantages, chemical compounds and fertilizers can also be extracted. In addition to programmable logic controllers with high accuracy, resilience, and quick reaction times for decision-making, processors and monitoring systems are needed to prevent any malfunction that could interrupt the treatment and jeopardize human consumption. Through a communication system that depends on quickly obtaining and reacting to data, this study will make use of programmable logic controllers (PLC), which depend on dependable communication networks and quick transmission and reception speeds. Furthermore, transmitting and receiving signals guarantees exact error detection protection and correct synchronization in the event that any communication system component fails. A highly reliable and accurate communication network based on communication protocols is achieved when the PLC sends its data over long distances and, depending on the cables used, whether optical fiber or others, to the main center of the SCADA system to process the data according to the proposed scenario. This is because the system operates in real-time, which explains why it achieves acquisition and processing in a short amount of time, approximately 10 milliseconds, or the total time to acquire and process all system parameters reaches 140 milliseconds.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Digital Filter Design: A Review Paper
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Digital filters are used in a variety of applications. One of the main objectives of creating digital filters is to approach the desired response. Filter design supplies the specifications, calculates the coefficients, and implements the filter on the hardware. Digital filters are typically used to process and produce the desired signal, like pictures or video streams, and this has compelled scientists, engineers, and researchers to use newly developed current tools and technology to create digital signal processing systems utilizing inventive, skilful, and intelligent ways. Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) has emerged as a significant digital circuit implementation medium in the past decade. This paper offers several methods for designing the digital filter. The article also surveys contemporary FPGA architecture. A smaller number of multipliers and adders are used in the FPGA-based digital filter design to reduce complexity and decrease expense. Compared to the conventional methods, FPGA design performs better due to its parallel processing.

articleTitle: Real-time Crowd Detection of Vehicles: Approaches and Open Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Real-time vehicle crowd detection has become an urgent necessity technique for many applications like traffic control management, monitoring, and self-driving. Traffic crowds sometimes happen because many vehicles are located in the same place or take the same route without alternative routes. This leads to unwanted crowding, even though alternative paths can be taken. Many recent technologies have been suggested to solve crowd issues such as smart traffic lights and optimized GPS routes and others. However, in-vehicle crowding detection solutions are rarely based on embedded devices using machine learning algorithms. Smart embedded engineering systems with limited resources can challenge implementing efficient crowded vehicle detection algorithms. Recent machine learning technologies have tried to overcome these challenges. This review paper aims to provide a clear overview on embedded systems, applications, case studies, used datasets, online development platforms, machine learning approaches, and available frameworks for Lite deep and machine learning algorithms to be a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners alike allowing to suggest both create image dataset and smart embedded system of crowd vehicle detection. A list of an existing vehicle crowd detection approaches systems and technologies has been listed in a table for comparison. Various methodologies, open challenges, and future directions in these domains are also discussed to be utilized in future works.

articleTitle: Review of Skin Cancer Detection and Diagnosis by Applying Different Models of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The use of deep learning and machine learning models for automated skin cancer diagnosis is growing in popularity. Skin conditions that are common and can have life-threatening implications include vascular lesions, actinic keratosis, basal cell carcinoma, melanoma, benign keratosis, and melanocytic nevi. Early identification of skin cancer allows patients to treat the condition and reduces the fatality rate. Skin cancer identification is difficult since diverse skin lesions have many features. Many studies presented a range of advanced models aimed at solving the challenges of automatic skin cancer diagnosis. This article will examine the recently proposed machine learning models developed to identify and categorize skin disorders with different types of skin cancer datasets that have been recently used in many studies and applications, as well as assist readers in understanding the field's limitations and unsolved problems. The performance of many sophisticated machine learning and transfer learning algorithms is assessed in this review study.

articleTitle: Design, Monitor and Controll a System for Smart Substation Grid Using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Over time, power grids have evolved from standalone structures to interconnected networks that produce, transfer, distribute, and supply electrical energy to end users. For instance, smart power plants play a crucial role in smart grids by supplying consumers with safe, efficient, and dependable electrical energy distribution through switching, conversion, monitoring, measuring, and protection functions. Smart power plants that are digital and have better connectivity are the latest evolution in power grid technology, which has been closely followed by the digitization of all its components and advancements in communication and computer infrastructure. However, mishaps involving linked smart power plants can cause power outages and problems to propagate across the grid, damaging electrical equipment in other parts of the country. Our goal in this study is to develop a cloud-based system for smart substation monitoring and control over the Internet. Through remote monitoring via the cloud, this system is able to identify problems that could cause the electrical system to shut down. In addition, the system's design cost is minimal, and its data storage capacity is exceptionally large. This setup sends data from smart grid devices to the cloud for management and monitoring using an ESP 32 microcontroller and high-precision sensors.

articleTitle: Encryption Audio Signal with IDEA Technique Enhanced by Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Block encryption using the International Data Encryption Algorithm (IDEA) is strong, efficient, and widely used, but brute force attackers can exploit its 128-bit key space. This paper proposes the integration of chaotic (Hanon Map) key generation into the conventional International Data Encryption Algorithm (IDEA) for voice encryption to increase the key space and incorporate nonlinearity to Henon map subkey generation. The Henon map, a chaotic sequence, and permuting the extended IDEA key bits make the IDEA key schedule appropriate for audio encryption and resistant to cryptanalytic attacks. We verify the method’s security using differential and linear cryptanalysis. Results show chaotic key generation greatly improves IDEA audio encryption security. The expanded key space and nonlinearity protect sensitive audio data from cipher breaks. The simulation results of voice encryption based on IDEA and chaos indicate that the mean squared error is very close to one, the correlation is very close to zero, and the signal-to-noise ratio is greater than zero. Employing a Henon chaotic system expands the key space from 128 bits to 327 bits.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Eye Diseases using Hybrid Deep Features with Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In ophthalmic diagnostics, it is essential to identify certain ocular conditions in fundus images. This work presents the Decision Tree (DT) algorithm, an automated multi-label deep learning classification system that integrates deep feature representations from pairs of fundus images (e.g., left and right eyes) to diagnose multiple ocular disorders. The benchmark structured fundus image dataset Ocular Disease Intelligent Recognition (ODIR-5K) has been used to classify fundus images into normal, diabetes, glaucoma, cataract, age-related macular degeneration, hypertension, pathological myopia, and others. Our suggested approach consists of three steps: pre-processing, deep feature extraction based on transfer learning concepts, and classification using a classical decision tree classifier. The study initiates a comprehensive image pre-processing procedure, including circular border cropping, image resizing, data balancing, and data augmentation. The work aims to categorize a dataset of eye diseases using DT and Hybrid Features (HF) based transfer learning models. This approach has been applied to identify the eye disease dataset based on fused characteristics from the EffiientB6 and Densnet169 models as transfer learning models. The final classifier (Decision Tree) achieved an F1-score of 99.02%, accuracy of 99.02%, precision of 99.04%, and recall of 99.01%.

articleTitle: Enhancement of a Smart Assistive Cane for Visually Impaired People Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of an intelligent assistive cane for visually impaired individuals, integrating multiple sensors and wireless communication technologies to enhance mobility and safety. The system incorporates an ultrasonic sensor, a GPS device, a gyroscope, and a heartbeat rate sensor, all connected to an Arduino microcontroller. The ultrasonic sensor detects obstacles in the user’s path, providing real-time feedback to help avoid collisions. The GPS device enables outdoor navigation, offering location tracking and assistance for route guidance. The gyroscope measures the orientation and movement of the cane, providing data for better navigation control and detecting sudden changes in posture. Additionally, the heartbeat rate sensor continuously monitors the user’s physical condition, alerting them of any abnormal readings. The data collected by these sensors is wirelessly transmitted to a cloud computing platform for real-time processing and analysis. This cloud-based approach allows for continuous monitoring, remote assistance, and data storage, offering a robust, scalable solution for enhancing the independence and safety of visually impaired individuals. The design of the intelligent cane provides an innovative approach to assistive technology, combining environmental sensing, health monitoring, and cloud integration to offer a comprehensive aid for the visually impaired.

articleTitle: Phasor Measurement Unit Application in Electrical Grids for Monitoring and Control: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Managing electrical power distribution from different generating platforms, through transmission lines with a variety of transformers, is a major challenge due to energy losses and risks of collapse of transmission and distribution networks due to unpredicted load fluctuations. In addition to the large areas over which the network is distributed, the emergence of modern technologies for producing electrical energy from renewable and environmentally friendly sources requires monitoring and control technologies that are different from conventional sources in coordinating a response to load changes. As a result of the multiplicity of technologies used in analyzing and managing electrical energy, the phase measurement unit (PMU) technology emerged as a valuable source of information. The PMU provides many advantages over its predecessor such as the SCADA technology. Information gathered from PMU technology can be used for, monitoring, detecting frequency fluctuations, voltage profile changes, accuracy in load modeling, analysis, and control of subsystems and events that occur within the system. In this paper, the PMU structure and construction components are discussed with the principle of operation. Furthermore, the benefits of PMU in electrical grids are explored in order to provide an understanding of how PMU computes with other systems such as SCADA. A comparison is provided between PMU and SCADA technologies to exemplify the merits and justify future research on PMUs. The study concludes by stating the importance of PMU in addressing some of the previous papers and studies and stating the techniques used in design and connection within the network.

Author Keywords: monitoring and control of electrical grids

articleTitle: Review Study on Polar Encoding/Decoding, Applications and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: High speed communication became an essential necessity in the modern lifestyle. Therefore, new coding techniques were developed to fulfill the needs for such speeds required by the latest communication systems such as the 5G. One of the prominent coding schemes that attracted the attention of the developers is the polar coding that guarantees near Shannon channel capacity speed limit. However, the polar codes decoding is difficult due to the soft detection of the received data. Despite that, the polar coding is implemented in submersive vessels, adverse nonlinear channels and deeps space communication. This paper presents a review on the polar encoding/decoding from the theory, techniques point of view, areas of implementation and challenges facing the polar codes for future applications.

articleTitle: Secure Data Hiding with Chaotic Maps
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The important areas for preventing hackers and spies from accessing private information without authorization are cryptography and steganography. Both methods can be applied separately or in tandem. The process of converting data into a format that cannot be read by anybody without the right decryption key is known as cryptography. Steganography, on the other hand, aims to hide data in a cover medium in a way that is invisible to the human eye. In order to improve the safety and reliability of data transmission networks, this study presents a high-resolution chaotic technique for embedding information into images. Higher levels of data hiding are achieved by the system through the integration of steganography and encryption. The suggested technique use the chaotic systems to produce a Random Index Vector (RIV) that preserves image quality by concealing data within the Least Significant Bits (LSB) of image pixels. The efficiency of the algorithm is illustrated by the simulation results which show a PSNR of 68.97 dB and an MSE value of 0.0076.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Space Division Multiplexing Techniques and Components In Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: For several decades, optical communications technology has advanced significantly and steadily, becoming an indispensable resource in our society and economy that are becoming more and more dependent on information. The physical capabilities of single-mode fiber optic cables are approaching their capacity limits. Therefore, to deal with increasing and surprisingly huge bandwidth requirements, other solutions are urgently needed. Space division multiplexing (SDM) was therefore touted as a promising, innovative solution that would significantly increase the optic fiber limit. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the evolved space division multiplexing (SDM) research, discussing the various categorizations and characteristics of new space division multiplexing (SDM) fibers like fiber bundles, multi-element fibers (MEF), multi-core fiber (MCF), few-mode fiber (FMF), coupled-core fiber (CC), and few-mode multi-core fiber (FM-MCF). Subsequently, we delve into the research accomplishments associated with each of these fiber types. Furthermore, this paper examines the advancements in amplifier technology as well as multiplexer/demultiplexer technology. Lastly, we do inter-fiber type comparisons.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Amplitude Shaping Performance over FSO Atmospheric Turbulence Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Free-space optics (FSO) shows great promise for ultra-high-capacity wireless communication. Still, it faces limitations due to power fluctuations from atmospheric turbulence, weather, and pointing errors. Probabilistic Amplitude Shaping (PAS) addresses these challenges, optimizing the achievable rate in Log-normal and Gamma-Gamma turbulence channels. This study uses a Modified Multi-Repeat Mapping (MMRM) scheme optimized via the Water Cycle Algorithm (WCA) to adjust probability mass functions (PMFs) and reduce FSO impairments. Results demonstrate that the proposed non-uniformly shaped QAM significantly outperforms conventional uniform QAM under similar turbulence conditions, yielding SNR gains of {4.3, 2.8} dB for PAS-16-QAM at L={10,30}L={10,30}, {3.5, 2.5} dB for PAS-32-QAM at L={50,70}L={50,70}, and {4.1, 2.6} dB for PAS-64-QAM at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> SER compared to uniform QAM.

articleTitle: Classification of Audio Signals Based on Deep Learning Methods for Google Net and Alex Net
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Audio signals have a significant impact on every element of human life. Audio classification systems can be developed to solve the efficiency problems of conventional methods using the learning capabilities of cloud computing and deep learning architectures. This research proposes deep learning techniques to classify environmental audio signals based on the spectrograms generated for these sounds while using deep learning techniques. Spectrogram images of environmental audio signals train deep-learning networks such as Google Net and Alex Net on cloud computing. Both networks are trained on a large number of datasets. The achieved accuracy can reach 92.5% on Google Net, and 87.5% on Alex Net. This paper provides that the proposed technique for audio signal classification can be efficient for sound classification and recognition systems.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: A New Design Of T-Shaped Patch Antennas For 5G MIMO Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The design and optimization of T-shaped patch antennas for MIMO applications of contemporary wireless communication schemes are presented in this paper. Electromagnetic modeling systems have become essential for developing and improving wireless networks due to the rapid rise of wireless communication technologies, including 5G and beyond. A test Poisson’s ratio of 0.33, a Young’s modulus of 120 KN/mm2, annealed copper as a lossy metal, the electrical conductivity 5.8e+7 s/m, and a specific heat value of 390 [1/K/kg] are used in the preparation of the model for the antenna structure. T-shaped patch antennas (MIMO) are the type of antenna utilized in modern wireless applications. Two T-shaped antennas are put on top of a 37 × 44 mm2 FR4 substrate, which has a thickness of 0.035 mm. The unit cell is constructed with a width of 5.00 mm. The external lengths are 4.20mm and 3.45mm. The present study aims to reduce mutual coupling between two patch antennas by enhancing their isolation through the use of five meta-material unit cells. The two antennas operate at a frequency of 5.8GHz. Computer Simulation Technology (CST) software is used to simulate their antenna efficiency, realized gain, diversity gain, and surface current distribution at 99%, 4 dB, 9.99 dB, and 375 A/m, respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Planning of 5G Radio Links over on Hillah City
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: As wireless services become more prevalent, it is anticipated that 5G will address the issues related to data transfer speed that were present in earlier generations. In this particular situation, it is crucial to carefully construct a stable 5G wireless access connection over a varied landscape in a suburban setting, such as the city of Hilla mentioned in this study. Over the terrain, line-of-sight propagation was accomplished with success. However, because to path-loss limitations, vegetation, and rain loss, the signal intensity has dropped below the receiver sensitivity of −84 dBm. Therefore, even with the employment of high-gain antennas and beam-forming methods, the 28 GHz carrier frequency microwave connection is inappropriate. Since it has demonstrated better performance, the 3.5 GHz frequency is advised for establishing efficient communication over many kilometers of distance. The base station’s location and the transmitting antenna’s elevation were tuned to create strong connections in Hillah. The antenna height was 10 meters to provide line of sight across the five sites, resulting in signal strengths of −69.5039 dBm, −55.1312 dBm, −66.0844 dBm, −66.0968 dBm, −50.9748 dBm for Hillah City Center, Hillah Football Stadium, Hillah Textile Factory, Officers Park, and Recreation Farm, respectively. For the 28 GHz link connection, the path loss due to foliage was 22.7422 dBm, resulting in signal strengths of −98.5737 dBm, −86.2864 dBm, −95.568 dBm, −99.5514 dBm, −79.859 dBm for Hilla City Center, Hilla Football Stadium, Hilla Textile Factory, Officers Park, and Recreation Farm, respectively.

articleTitle: Adaptive Quaternion Network with Contextual Feature Enhancement for Robust Single Image Deraining
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Rain streaks can impair object detection and recognition in computer vision. Complex rain patterns challenge current deraining processes, resulting in poor performance. The Adaptive Quaternion Network with Contextual Feature Enhancement (AQN-CFE), a deep learning model, efficiently removes rain from single images. AQN-CFE captures spatial and color features using quaternion representation, and its contextual feature enhancement module preserves fine details in heavy rain images. On the Rain100H dataset, AQN-CFE outperformed previous approaches with a PSNR of 31.8 dB, SSIM of 0.91, and MAE of 3.5. PSNR increases by 2.3 dB, SSIM by 0.04, and MAE decreases by 15%. These results demonstrate that AQN-CFE improves visual clarity, making it appropriate for autonomous driving and video surveillance.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Technique for Classifying Ocular Diseases Using Deep Learning and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Ocular problems, including glaucoma and retinal detachment, are caused by different factors such as diabetes. They cause a range of severe symptoms of blindness around the world. Early detection is challenging due to the complexity of time demands and potential inaccuracies in manual diagnosis. This research proposes a hybrid deep learning approach that utilizes feature extraction using convolutional neural networks (CNN) for classification via traditional machine learning techniques. The Ocular Diseases Intelligent Recognition (ODIR), a dataset containing 10,000 ocular images from 5,000 persons, was utilized for performance evaluation. This research seeks to deliver precise diagnoses of ocular disorders using deep learning methodologies, thereby enhancing healthcare quality, especially ocular health. The findings show that the best accuracy (97.34%) for eight-class classification was attained using a proposed CNN for feature extraction and employing a multi-support vector machine (MSVM) as the classifier to score a high accuracy. The results indicate that the suggested model may enhance accuracy in diagnosing eye diseases while addressing challenges in multi-class classification.

articleTitle: MIMO-OFDM Wireless Communication Systems: a Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: The Multiple Input Multiple Output Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) method blends two advanced techniques: Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) and Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM). It is a type of wireless communication. MIMO uses more than one antenna at the transmitter and the receiver to make wireless communication systems work better and hold more data. MIMO enhances data transmission speeds, mitigates interference, and extends the range of wireless connections by using numerous antennas. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a digital multicarrier modulation technique that divides the available bandwidth into several orthogonal subcarriers. Each subcarrier transmits a data segment, with all subcarriers modulated and sent simultaneously. This technique renders OFDM exceptionally proficient in alleviating the impacts of multipath fading and interference inside wireless communication networks. MIMO OFDM is extensively utilized in wireless communication systems such as 4G LTE, Wi-Fi, and WiMAX to provide high-speed and dependable wireless connectivity. It has several benefits compared to conventional single-antenna and single-carrier communication systems, such as elevated data rates, superior spectral efficiency, augmented dependability, and enhanced resistance to fading and interference. This study presents the literature on wireless communication in MIMO-OFDM utilizing several substandards.

articleTitle: Enhancing Thyroid Ultrasound Image Classification with Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Ultrasound imaging is the primary diagnostic tool for thyroid nodules. However, clinical decisions regarding these nodules often involve subjective judgments influenced by individual experience and practice variability. To improve the objectivity and accuracy of these decisions, this study proposes a VGG-16-based deep learning model for accurately predicting the benign or malignant nature of thyroid nodules. The objective was to classify thyroid ultrasound images into two categories: benign and malignant. To achieve this, a dataset of thyroid ultrasound images was collected from The Cancer Genome Atlas Thyroid Cancer (TCGA-THCA) repository and the Digital Database of Thyroid Ultrasound Images (DDTI). To augment the dataset and mitigate overfitting, histogram equalization was employed. The proposed model leverages the pre-trained VGG-16 architecture, which was fine-tuned to achieve optimal performance in distinguishing benign and malignant thyroid nodules. This study focuses on optimizing model parameters and architecture to enhance the efficiency of the proposed approach. For the assessment of the performance of the proposed DL model, accuracy, sensitivity, recall, intersection over union (IoU), specificity, and F1-score will be calculated in the study. The results will also be compared with other classification methods that used transfer learning to determine the degree of deep learning in classifying liver tumors. Our research yielded the greatest possible results, which we got, reaching 99.80% accuracy, 100% precision, F1- scare 98.9%, and a recall of 98%.

articleTitle: Dynamic Power Allocation Strategies for Enhanced Performance in MIMO-NOMA-OQAM-FBMC Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: In wireless networks, radio resources are typically allocated to users through Orthogonal Multiple Access (OMA) techniques. However, as the number of users grows, the performance of the network can be significantly enhanced by integrating Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) with a MIMO-NOMA-OQAM-FBMC system. NOMA offers notable improvements in key performance metrics, including outage probability, bit error rate (BER), spectral efficiency, and latency. This paper investigates the effect of NOMA, particularly when coupled with fair power allocation strategies, on the system’s performance, especially in terms of outage probability. The study compares fixed and dynamic power allocation schemes, assessing their impact on BER and achievable rates. The MIMO-NOMA-OQAM-FBMC system utilizes Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) at the receiver to decode user data, a process that can be complex, especially when SIC is imperfect. In the dynamic power allocation approach, higher power is typically allocated to users who are further away, which may lead to increased outage probability for closer users. To address this, a novel fair power allocation technique is proposed that adjusts power distribution to minimize outage probability while meeting each user’s target rate and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) requirements. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed power allocation strategy significantly improves outage probability compared to conventional methods, offering a more reliable and efficient solution for multi-user systems.

articleTitle: Review of Advanced Machine Learning Methods for Lung Disease Diagnoses: Pre-processing, Features Extraction, Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 3rd International Conference on Advances in Engineering Science and Technology (AEST)
abstract: Diseases of the lung are common throughout the globe. (COPD) chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, Tuberculosis diseases, pneumonia diseases, asthma, fibrosis, and Lung cancer are the most prevalent types of lung illness. It is crucial to detect lung disease at the earliest opportunity. Many deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) patterns have been designed for this aim. Patients with lung diseases are at higher risk of needing ventilators, experiencing breathing problems, and facing oral health issues compared to the general population. Early detection of these diseases can lead to quicker recovery and help prevent the illness from spreading throughout the body. Early diagnosis is crucial for better outcomes. If problems are detected and accurately reflected, additional details will be provided to begin risk improvement and management decision-making. There are many risks in the lung illness detection field of study; one of the issues is the low-resolution medical images utilized to construct a general model to treat various medical images. As an illustration (Computed Tomography, X-ray, and Magnetic Resonance Imaging) are used to create a model that can solve multi-class problems on any image and dimension (resize images), classification according to multiple labels problem. This paper outlines the key advancements in the application of artificial intelligence in medical image processing, namely in evaluating patients’ people in the pulmonary medicine field.
